events.text_en: Mục Vân Trang's remounts are lost with Lạc Hà's field on Chiết Kích Nguyên; for a century the manor breeds no war horses.
At the horse fair below Lạc Hà's seat Lạc Hà's treasurer shorts a Mục Vân herder three stones, and a market girl of eleven says so in front of them both.
Lạc Hà's Counting House will not delay Mục Vân Trang's tribute after the cold year; Khấu Mục Vân pays it less three stones and their interest, and has every year since.
Khấu Mục Vân buys the white bear from the north at Thiên Bảo Trai's spring auction, so that it will not be sold for its gall.
